findings.title_en: Worker without a hard hat in an operating forklift area
No marked separate walkways for pedestrians and forklifts
Loose material scattered on the floor of the travel area

summary_en: The report contains three findings: one high severity, one medium, and one low. The most urgent item is a worker without a hard hat in an active forklift operating area. Forklift movement in the shared work area must stop immediately until the worker wears a helmet and pedestrian routes are separated from forklift routes.
